papers.title: WEQA: Wearable hEalth Question Answering with Query-Adaptive Agentic Reasoning
papers.what: An agent framework with a language-model controller that routes each wearable-health question to a matching set of signal-analysis routines and pretrained models, reporting 24% higher accuracy than baselines with clinician-judged soundness.
papers.builds_on: TS-Agent (Liu 2025, I2CIT4I7); Sensor2Text (Chen 2024, ELYUE3NF); LLMs are Few-Shot Health Learners (Liu 2023, JX3X3KH5); LATS (Zhou 2024, 77ERE7HA)

papers.title: PerceptionDLM: Parallel Region Perception with Multimodal Diffusion Language Models
papers.what: A multimodal diffusion language model that decodes captions for several image regions in parallel via structured attention masking, beating LLaDA-V on 15 of 16 benchmarks while staying competitive with autoregressive vision-language models.
papers.builds_on: DiT (Peebles 2023, YJ9TK993); DDPM (Ho 2020, GX7WR7KA); DALL-E 2 (Ramesh 2022, DUERBZGM)

papers.title: Time-Series Foundation Model Embeddings for Remaining Useful Life Estimation
papers.what: Freezes a pretrained time-series foundation model (Chronos-2) and trains only a small regression head, showing the frozen embeddings beat recurrent, convolutional, Transformer, and gradient-boosting baselines for remaining-useful-life prediction.
papers.builds_on: LLMs for Time Series Survey (Zhang 2024, N2JLZBY3); TS-Agent (Liu 2025, I2CIT4I7); Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025, 2XWEG7AF)

papers.title: Neuro-JEPA: Learning a Sparse Latent Predictive Foundation Model for Multimodal Neuroimaging
papers.what: Pretrains a multimodal neuroimaging foundation model by predicting in a sparse learned latent space instead of reconstructing raw signal, producing transferable representations across imaging modalities.
papers.builds_on: MAE Theory (Zhang 2023, 6INGKIJV); SSL for HAR (Yuan 2024, RTMH75VW); Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025, 2XWEG7AF)
